northStar: Keep Scout's useful behavior in owned, testable harness assets so the model can be swapped without changing what field-ready answers require.

proofDomain.current: Appalachian Trail hiker and document-agent questions for Dad's Hoggcountry app
proofDomain.transferTarget: Private document corpora such as company SOPs, project notes, customer documents, and user-owned vault notes
proofDomain.rule: The AT suite is the narrow proof domain, not a prompt-memorization target or product boundary.

ownedAssets.purpose: Stable benchmark cases with expected traits, required tools, safety caveats, and reading/writing coverage.
The same suite embedded in the app path Dad will run.
Bundled searchable documents that support offline source-backed answers.
Deterministic location, water, shelter, town, terrain, park-service, and trail-condition context.
Owned runners, reviewers, planners, status checks, and proof gates.

swappableIntelligenceLayers.role: Tool and source-routing smoke tests only
Mac-side local model bridge for iteration before iOS proof
Debug iPhone Simulator or device lane using the native ScoutGemma bridge
Dad final proof lane through the installed TestFlight iPhone app

newModelLaneRequirements: A new model lane must reuse the canonical suite, answer contract, review rubric, and proof gates unchanged.
It must record modelId, provider or runtime, mode, app build, install source, suite version/hash, and proof lane.
It must preserve required tool calls, source receipts, opened-document ids, and document-writing confirmation metadata.
It must not change expectedTraits, safetyCaveats, requiredTools, or human ratings to make a model pass.
localFirstChecks: Cloud, browser, and scaffold runs are iteration diagnostics only and cannot become final Dad proof.
Debug simulator/on-device Gemma Run 100 must pass with complete tools, source evidence, and answer-quality scan before Dad spends TestFlight time.
Final proof requires a real TestFlight/iPhone install source, the current 100-case suite, human 5/5 review, and repeated strict stability proof.
fallbackRules: If a model cannot use tools, receipts, source-document opening, or confirmation metadata reliably, classify the miss as local-model-limitation, weak-tool, bad-routing, or poor-document-writing-flow instead of weakening the suite.
Switching models creates a new evidence lane until it passes the same run, review, source, and proof gates.
A model may draft prose, but deterministic tools and document contracts remain the authority for trail facts, source-backed claims, and user-owned document writes.

contextIsolationProtocol.rule: Each eval case must run as a fresh task with only declared case state, current location/profile context, cached field-pack data, user-vault summaries, relevant source documents, and tool schemas. Prior answers, review notes, and hidden chat history cannot leak into the next case.
caseInputs: cached field pack and bundled source documents
declared user-vault document summaries or draft fixtures
declared conversation fixture only when a case explicitly tests follow-up behavior
conversationFixturePolicy: Follow-up cases may use a declared conversation fixture, but not a previous answer generated earlier in the same run.
A targeted rerun of a follow-up case must receive the same declared fixture as the full-suite run.
The exported transcript must identify the fixture so reviewers can separate intentional context from hidden leakage.

toolContracts.rule: Use search to select candidate sources, not to silently answer from memory.
Open the selected document before relying on specific source text or user vault content.
Location-aware answers must identify the mile basis and caveat uncertain or stale position.
Water answers must separate known distance from flow, treatment, and freshness uncertainty.
Town answers must use structured service context or say when details are missing.
Weather answers must cite cached or fetched forecast timing and avoid pretending stale weather is live.

fieldDecisionToolAuthority.rule: For field-critical hiker decisions, deterministic cached tools and source receipts are the authority. The model may explain the decision, but it cannot replace missing tool evidence with fluent prose.

decisionGates.task: How far to the next water and should I carry more?
How far to the next town/resupply and what can I do there?
How hard is today going to be?
answerMustSeparate: lower-risk stop or bailout option when useful

decisionGates.task: What's the weather tomorrow or what happens if the weather cache is stale?
What can Scout answer offline after I refreshed in town?

rules: Use deterministic tools before prose for water, shelter, town, weather, distance, terrain, safety, and document-vault questions.
Name source-backed facts separately from assumptions, estimates, or user-provided context.
Prefer concise field wording over generic AI filler.

saveRules: Never save or overwrite without explicit user confirmation.
Show a reviewable draft before saving.
Separate source-backed facts, assumptions, private placeholders, and open questions.
Preserve recoverable or versioned changes for user-owned vault documents.

independentReviewers.input: final answer, required tools, toolInvocations, receipts, and sourceDocumentIds
checks: required source-backed tools were actually invoked
specific water, shelter, town, weather, safety, and document-vault claims have receipts or opened source documents
answer names missing or stale source data instead of filling gaps from model memory

independentReviewers.input: current mile, structured trail data, answer text, and distance/tool summaries
checks: distance, direction, next-water, next-town, shelter, and terrain statements match structured data
cached or candidate trail facts are labeled with freshness and reliability caveats
unsafe mileage or navigation certainty is rejected before 5-star review

independentReviewers.input: answer text, documentTask, expected traits, required confirmations, and vault-write metadata
checks: source-backed facts are separated from placeholders, assumptions, and open questions
no user-owned document is saved or overwritten without explicit confirmation and recoverable/versioned changes

independentReviewers.input: runContext, app build, install source, model/runtime, suite version/hash, and review status
checks: simulator, browser, cloud, scaffold, and TestFlight iPhone evidence stay separate
final proof uses the current suite and real TestFlight/iPhone install source
stability requires two distinct strict full runs

reviewGates.rule: Review must include source grounding, trail math/safety, document-writing, and proof-lane checks that are separate from the answer generation path.
Required tool hits must be backed by actual toolInvocations, receipts, or sourceDocumentIds.
Final answer quality is human-rated 1-5 with notes and rubric checks.
Any rating below 5 requires failure categories, owner layer, and a concrete improvement task.
Final proof requires a full current-suite TestFlight iPhone run with all 100 cases rated 5/5.
Final stability requires two distinct strict TestFlight iPhone runs.

antiOverfitRules: Do not weaken expected traits or safety caveats to close a review item.
Do not fix a miss by memorizing one prompt when the failure belongs to a tool, source, data table, prompt policy, UI recovery state, or local model lane.
Prefer improvements that help neighboring hiker/document-agent questions.
Keep simulator, browser, cloud, scaffold, and TestFlight iPhone proof lanes separate.
